title: Power Apps: Power Platform connectors in generative pages
summary: Hold: the briefing postpones checking data policies even though Microsoft's platform guidance covers connector connections used by apps. The policy-creation command is not runnable as printed, and the connection-reference UI link does not document the complete path shown.

claims.claim: The described workflow starts by creating and authenticating a connection and adding a connection reference to the environment.

claims.claim: The designer exposes connector data through Add data > Connectors.
claims.quote: To use data from a Power Platform connector (preview), select **Add data** > **Connectors**, select the prepared connection reference, and choose the connector data that the page should use.

claims.claim: AI code generation tools such as GitHub Copilot CLI can create connector-backed generative pages.
claims.quote: This article describes how to use AI code generation tools, such as GitHub Copilot CLI, to create and edit generative pages for model-driven apps in Power Apps. ... Pages can use Microsoft Dataverse tables, Power Platform connectors (preview), and Dataverse custom APIs (preview).

claims.where: What's changing; Cost and licensing; Scope
claims.claim: Learn currently labels connector support in generative pages as preview.
claims.quote: Connector support, Custom API support, and Application Insights telemetry for generative pages are preview features.

claims.claim: Connector support lets generative pages use data outside Dataverse.
claims.quote: Connector support lets a generative page use data outside of Dataverse through the Power Platform connector ecosystem. All Power Platform connectors are supported.

claims.claim: Connector-backed pages can show or change data in external services such as SharePoint, SQL and SaaS systems.
claims.quote: All Power Platform connectors are supported.

claims.claim: Generative page code is AI-generated.
claims.quote: After you describe the page, the system then processes your requirements and specifications and intelligently generates React code

claims.claim: Pages can display connector data to app users.
claims.quote: For example, ask the agent to create a page that displays documents from a SharePoint list.

claims.claim: Learn advises testing connector-backed pages with the identities and permissions users will use.
claims.quote: Review the connector data source in the plan before you approve the build. Test the generated page with the identities and permissions that your users will use.

claims.claim: A connection is a stored authentication credential for a connector.
claims.quote: A connection is a stored authentication credential for a connector, for example OAuth credentials for the SharePoint connector.

claims.claim: The connector methods reference exposes create, update and delete row operations.
claims.quote: Creates a new row in the specified connector table. ... Deletes a row from the specified connector table. ... Updates an existing row in the specified connector table.

claims.claim: Connector calls reject their promises for unresolved connection references or unauthorised connections.
claims.quote: when the connection reference can't be resolved, the connection isn't authorized and the user doesn't complete the consent prompt, or the connector returns an error status.
claims.fix: Replace the final sentence with: 'The connector methods reference says calls reject the returned promise when, for example, the connection reference cannot be resolved, or the connection is not authorised and the user does not complete the consent prompt.'

claims.claim: Connector use is maker-selected, with no documented separate administrator enablement switch for this capability.
claims.quote: Searched: "generative pages" connectors enable disable admin PowerShell Power Platform API pac setting. Opened generative-pages and generative-page-external-tools; read pac admin and Power Apps PowerShell search excerpts. Maker selects connectors; no feature-specific switch found.

claims.claim: Power Platform admin center > Security > Data and privacy > Data policy > New Policy reaches data-policy creation.
claims.quote: select **Security**, and then on the **Security** pane, select **Data and privacy**. ... select **Data policy**. ... select **New Policy** to create a new policy to configure.

claims.claim: New-DlpPolicy (Microsoft.PowerApps.Administration.PowerShell) is a runnable policy-creation call.
claims.quote:
New-DlpPolicy
    -NewPolicy <Object>
    [-ApiVersion <String>]
    [<CommonParameters>]
claims.fix: Replace controls[0].api.call and the rendered command with 'New-DlpPolicy -NewPolicy $NewPolicy'. The module name is metadata, not a parenthesised argument; $NewPolicy is the policy-definition object placeholder documented by the reference.

claims.claim: A data policy's Prebuilt Connectors page exposes Configure connector > Connector endpoints for the selected connector.
claims.quote: If the value of the **Endpoint configurable** column is **Yes**, you can use this capability by right-clicking and then selecting **Configure connector** > **Connector endpoints**.

claims.claim: New-PowerAppDlpPolicyConnectorConfigurations with TenantId, PolicyName and NewDlpPolicyConnectorConfigurations creates endpoint-filtering configurations.
claims.quote: New-PowerAppDlpPolicyConnectorConfigurations -TenantId $TenantId -PolicyName $PolicyName -NewDlpPolicyConnectorConfigurations $ConnectorConfigurations

claims.claim: Endpoint filtering is a preview capability restricted to supported prebuilt connectors marked Endpoint configurable = Yes.
claims.quote: The **Endpoint configurable** column on the **Prebuilt Connectors** page in **Data Policies** indicates whether the endpoint filtering capability is supported for the connector.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not confirmed that data policies apply to generative-page connector use, so checking them should wait for confirmation.
claims.quote:
Scan connections. If the policy blocks the whole connector, set the connection to a *disabled* state so that it can't operate.
7. Any resources that are running and attempting to use an inactive connection, action, trigger, or MCP server that is blocked, fail at runtime.
claims.fix: Replace the unconfirmed-data-policy statements with: 'Platform data policies can disable connections whose connectors are blocked; resources using inactive connections fail at runtime. The feature-specific enforcement sequence is not described.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/power-platform/admin/wp-data-loss-prevention. Change the Before rollout bullet to 'Check data policies for the connectors makers are likely to use.' Remove the open question asking whether data policies apply; retain the narrower question about the designer and AI plugin enforcement sequence.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not confirmed whether endpoint-filtering controls apply to generative pages.
claims.quote: Connector endpoint filtering lets admins control which specific endpoints makers can connect to when building apps, flows, or chatbots. It's configured within a data policy
claims.fix: Replace the unconfirmed endpoint-filtering statements with: 'Endpoint filtering is a preview platform control for supported connectors and static endpoints selected at design time; rules do not apply to environment variables, custom inputs or dynamically bound runtime endpoints.' Keep the existing cited endpoint-filtering URL. Narrow the open question to 'How are connector endpoints evaluated in the generative page designer and AI plugin?'

claims.claim: Connector action control can narrow the actions exposed by a permitted connector.
claims.quote: You can use connector action control to allow or block individual actions or triggers within a given connector.

claims.claim: A connection reference is a solution component pointing to a connection for a particular connector.
claims.quote: A connection reference is a solution component that contains a reference to a connection about a specific connector.

claims.claim: During solution import into a target environment, a connection is provided for each connection reference.
claims.quote: During solution import into a target environment, a connection is provided for all the connection references
